data.name: Intimidating Glare
data.description: You add your Strength modifier in place of your Charisma modifier on all Intimidate checks to demoralize a foe. You can attempt an Intimidate check to demoralize an adjacent foe as a move action instead of a standard action. If you successfully demoralizes an adjacent foe, that foe is shaken for the remainder of your current rage.
